entries.name: artemis
entries.principle: Developed at Sachtler — the world's first modular camera stabilization system. Premiered at the NAB Show in Las Vegas. A kit-based architecture that lets operators assemble different camera configurations from a single shared system.

entries.name: TRINITY
entries.principle: Developed together with Dr. Roman Foltyn. The first hybrid rig to combine mechanical Steadicam stabilization and electronic gimbal stabilization in a single device. Enables continuous camera movement from any position — floor to overhead — without setup changes.

entries.name: TRINITY 2
entries.principle: Next-generation successor at ARRI. Reduced weight, expanded stabilization modes, refined operating logic. Concept, design, and development by Curt O. Schaller.
